India's hospital beds fall well short of world norms. Hospital beds per 1,000 population, latest published year: 1.59 India (2021, down from 2.13 in 2000); 3.29 World average (2021); 4.66 OECD average (2021).
data_points.value: 1.59 beds per 1,000 population (India, 2021); 2.13 beds per 1,000 population (India, 2000); 3.29 beds per 1,000 population (World, 2021); 4.66 beds per 1,000 population (OECD, 2021)

data_points.quote: Government facilities alone run at just 0.79 per 1,000.

Actual inflow has stayed small: $8.89 billion cumulative into 'Hospital & Diagnostic Centres' from April 2000 to June 2023, against roughly $21.6 billion for Drugs & Pharmaceuticals over a similar span, and a single-digit share of total FDI that peaked at 4.3% of all inflow in CY2023 and has fallen back to 2.0% in H1 2025.
